units.heading: Product Overview
units.text: Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Cpp is a C++ library for working with spreadsheet files, part of the Aspose.Cells family. It is distributed under the aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Cpp repository and supports the C++ ecosystem.

units.heading: Installation
units.text: The package is installed via CMake using the manifest at Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp/CMakeLists.txt. The project includes separate CMake manifests for tests (Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp/tests/CMakeLists.txt), test executables (Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp.Tests/CMakeLists.txt), and sample code (samples/CMakeLists.txt).

units.heading: Release State
units.text: All project components—main library, tests, test executables, and samples—are active and currently at an unknown version, as indicated by their CMake manifest entries.
